geometry.shape: Two equal C1 cubic-Bezier domes between one cylinder and two open cylindrical necks; not an isotensoid
geometry.parameter_conversion: R=inner_radius_mm; each other physical dimension equals its dimensionless ratio times R
fixed_geometry_features: No variation in winding angle or dome control fractions

eligibility_gates_before_any_solve.parallel_tangent_scale_formula: 1 + t*kappa for n=(dz,-dr)/|d|, checked for all t between zero and total wall
eligibility_gates_before_any_solve.clearance_interpretation: Sampled nearest-curve gap is an additional sanity gate, not a global CAD distance proof; same-parameter normal spacing alone cannot exclude nonlocal intersections

baseline_geometry_evidence.note: The existing baseline checked positive profiles, normal offsets and real mesh Jacobians; no unsampled global-clearance proof is claimed

sampling_and_split_candidate.sampling: One baseline + fourteen one-parameter extrema + nine maximin Latin-hypercube points for 24 pilot train geometries; remaining 976 distinct constrained Latin-hypercube geometries
sampling_and_split_candidate.coordinate_space: Seven independent coordinates listed in candidate_independent_ranges, each mapped linearly from [0,1]
sampling_and_split_candidate.pilot_split: All 24 pilot geometries belong to train; randomly assign the other 976 to 776 train / 100 validation / 100 test before reading labels
sampling_and_split_candidate.pilot_selection: Pilot extrema change one coordinate at a time while others stay at their baseline ratios; nine space-filling points add interactions
sampling_and_split_candidate.before_label_manifest: Store immutable case ID, complete geometry, split, source/protocol hash and eligibility outcome before solving
sampling_and_split_candidate.rejected_geometry_policy: Deterministic pre-label rejection/resampling with candidate attempt IDs and rejection reason recorded; freeze the manifest before solves
sampling_and_split_candidate.solver_failure_policy: Retain failed case ID and traceback; do not silently replace, change resolution/material/BC, or relabel splits
sampling_and_split_candidate.no_mesh_or_pressure_leakage: All meshes/resolutions/pressure rescalings of one geometry inherit one split; pilot results are not a test set

fixed_material_candidate.liner: Reported Aluminum 6061-T6 isotropic E=69000 MPa, nu=0.33
fixed_material_candidate.overwrap: Reported AS4/3501-6 full nine orthotropic constants, copied exactly from the source config; no transversely-isotropic closure substitution
fixed_material_candidate.scope: Fixed reported elastic benchmark inputs, not certified material lots or validated manufactured vessel properties
fixed_material_candidate.bond: Conformal perfectly bonded shared material-interface nodes, no contact or delamination

fixed_layup_candidate.ply_order: Inner liner outward through four overwrap plies
fixed_layup_candidate.base_frame: m=-unit increasing-z meridian tangent, c=+e_theta, n=m cross c outward
fixed_layup_candidate.scope: Symmetric balanced numerical layup; not a winding-path/manufacturability claim. Retain utheta and local coupling even though membrane ply angles balance

fixed_load_and_boundary_candidate.pressure: Consistent -p*n_solid on the complete true inner wetted wall, exterior pressure zero
fixed_load_and_boundary_candidate.cap_equivalent_force_per_end_N: p*pi*boss_bore_radius_mm^2, bottom -z and top +z, each applied once
fixed_load_and_boundary_candidate.cap_distribution: Uniform axial traction on each complete annular end face, normalized by actual quadratic-surface integrated area
fixed_load_and_boundary_candidate.support: Sliding rigid axial end planes: bottom uz=0, top shared unknown uz master; radial and hoop end displacements free
fixed_load_and_boundary_candidate.rigid_motion_gauge_3d: Three tangential constraints at separated bottom outer-ring nodes remove only admissible in-plane translation/rotation rigid modes
fixed_load_and_boundary_candidate.rigid_motion_gauge_axisymmetric: One bottom outer utheta=0 gauge removes only rigid axial rotation; bottom uz already removes axial translation
fixed_load_and_boundary_candidate.physical_scope: Small-displacement static 3D linear elasticity of a double-open-neck test vessel with equivalent caps; not resolved bosses, mounting clamps, contact or actual closure geometry
fixed_load_and_boundary_candidate.scope_of_learning: Geometry generalization under one fixed load and material/layup protocol; no independent BC or pressure generalization claim

resolution_and_solver_decision.candidate_solver_route: Validated independent axisymmetric three-component fine FE field sampled at ALL original 3D Hex27 export-grid nodes; this is not a direct full-3D solve per export grid
resolution_and_solver_decision.reviewed_directional_convergence: Meridian-only 74048 to 113984 nodes: full U 0.369%, radial U 0.776%, energy 0.260%, extension 0.331%, maximum layer stress p95 change 1.602%
open_decisions: Root review of independent three-component axisymmetric versus 3D same-vessel cross-validation
Thickness resolution at each real material/ply boundary
Tangential displacement convergence with a predeclared relative/absolute tolerance for small utheta
Circumferential discretization or symmetry reduction error
Range-extreme geometry/field resolution on 24 pilot cases
Measured throughput and memory at the reviewed resolution
resolution_and_solver_decision.axisymmetric_route_rule: Can be selected only after same-domain cross-validation; if labels are lifted to a 3D mesh, explicitly record axisymmetric_3component origin and never describe them as independent full-3D solves
resolution_and_solver_decision.3d_quadrature: Existing intorder=5 volume and exact topology-reference surface mapping are the current benchmark, not yet a frozen all-geometry recipe
resolution_and_solver_decision.dimensionless_scales: Force=p*pi*inner_radius^2; moment=force*maximum geometric extent; keep absolute residuals as well

nodal: Full displacement U in global xyz
cell_and_GP: Material ID and physical ply ID
Full six-component stress and engineering strain with explicit Voigt order
Local material axes at every GP
label_schema_candidate.stress_association: Integration points within original cell order; no smoothing across material or +/-ply interfaces
diagnostics: Exact solver formulation and measured runtime/memory
label_schema_candidate.von_mises: Optional diagnostic only, not a composite failure criterion

pilot_and_throughput_candidate.launch_order: Resolve solver and baseline mesh gates first; review deterministic 24-geometry train pilot; freeze versioned protocol only after pilot review; then request/follow existing authorization for 1000-case production
pilot_and_throughput_candidate.memory_guard_action: Stop only the owning solver process, write failure state, preserve completed endpoints
pilot_and_throughput_candidate.candidate_two_worker_rule: Only after measured peak RAM and elapsed time on pilot cases; combined predicted peak plus 8 GiB reserve must fit available memory. Do not assume linear speedup
pilot_and_throughput_candidate.measurement_scope: One reported 113984-node case on this machine, one BLAS thread; not a range-wide production throughput guarantee
pilot_and_throughput_candidate.GPU: Keep FE sparse solves on validated CPU path; GPU remains available for TS3/MGN. No unvalidated GPU solver port solely to advertise acceleration

excluded_claims: Mesh convergence from conservation checks alone
next_action: Root review this candidate design and pending axisymmetric/3D/thickness evidence; no new solve or batch is triggered by this configuration
